news.headline: The Raiders have elected to utilize White's last practice squad elevation, allowing the team to carry the wide receiver
news.detail: The Raiders have elected to utilize White's last practice squad elevation, allowing the team to carry the wide receiver into game day for each of the first three weeks of the regular season. White caught two touchdowns on two targets for a total of 24 yards in the Raiders' Week 2 win over the Charge

profile: role: WR rotational — 5% of targets, 14% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
